title: GMV combines real engineering depth with membership of the six Spanish-capital integrators
content:
GMV is one of only six major Spanish-capital integrators, and the assessment credits it with real engineering depth while describing the supporting data as thin. Both halves matter: the ownership category is verified and rare, the depth judgement is not well evidenced.

Domestic Spanish ownership carries the same implication as elsewhere in this set — decisions about what the firm builds on are taken in-market rather than inherited from a group parent. Engineering depth, if it holds, would make GMV one of the more interesting Spanish leads, but the record does not establish what that depth consists of.

It sits at priority 4 needing an open-source screen, and the same pass should put evidence behind the depth claim rather than carrying it forward on assertion.
